Why the Ebola Outbreak Keeps Growing, According to Virus Expert Pardis Sabeti

The ongoing Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is now the second largest on record. The virus has infected more than 11,000 people in five countries and has killed more than 5,700 people as of Nov. 20. Pardis Sabeti, a leader at the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard who specializes in computational genetics and evolutionary biology, has tracked Ebola outbreaks for years.
